title: ODDPOLYQ13: polynomial odd ranks with a smaller source-flow budget

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE ODDPOLYQ13 algorithm and configuration completely specified in proof.md and odd_partition.md (finite exhaustive branch n<2^32768; otherwise k=n if odd else n+1, polynomial odd-token compiler with all history counted, r=ceil(sqrt(n)), L=ceilLog2(n), m0 the least nonnegative integer satisfying10m0^2>=7r^2, m=m0+256L, ell=floor(13r/10)-m-16L, dl=ceil(r/2), w=floor(r/2)-128L, finite source/demand/identity caps, uncapped measured tree and physical full-secret decoders) recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch, all failures, rejections and aborts included, its total charged sequential work T is O(2^((1336661/1000000)*sqrt(n)-n^(49/100))) with an absolute outside constant. Source and tree work, every allocated wire/record, compiler generation/history, lookup and address charge are counted. The negative49/100 term and outside sample power-10 are literal; no input-dependent compiler cost is treated as fixed. The chosen envelope has exact growth index1/2. The two supplied proof files contain all mathematical premises; no predecessor verdict or artifact-identity assertion is a premise.
